findings.rule: The police liaison role sees only vehicles under an investigative hold.
findings.evidence: Reproduced twice using fresh fixtures. On the latest run, after the supplied manager changed owner2 to liaison, vehicleDetail refused unheld vehicle 01M58GXESA6GKC8Z68XBFHD8D4 with NOT_FOUND, but myClaims returned claim 01M58GXESMKGP18GRKJ5WX07FP including the vehicle identifier, status, timestamp and proof asset 01M58GXESHDDD5VSDM01NCB46X. Downloading that ownership-proof asset returned HTTP 200. This is retained access to the former owner's own claim after a legitimate role change; it does not expose a different claimant's proof. The script restores the original owner role in finally.
